events.description: With `showPreviews`, called with every file the zone now holds, after a file is taken or removed.
events.name: onFilesChange

props.description: The headline in the zone; defaults to the `ui` catalogue's phrase.
props.name: label

props.description: A line under it, for example the accepted types and size.
props.name: description

props.description: The MIME types or extensions accepted; all when empty.
props.name: acceptedFileTypes

props.description: True to take more than one file.
props.name: allowsMultiple

props.description: True to refuse drops and picks.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: True to add a "Take a photo" button beside the file button (the camera on a phone, the webcam picker on web).
props.name: allowsCamera

props.description:
Web: true to take files pasted anywhere on the page (a copied screenshot), not only while the zone has focus;
a paste into a text field is left to that field. Native has no file clipboard and ignores it.
props.name: allowsPaste

props.description: True to keep the files taken and list them under the zone, an image as its thumbnail, each with a remove button.
props.name: showPreviews
